item.title: SHAFT 0.84.0
item.description:
Meetings reach the instances and the operator, and no recording is lost or hidden without saying so (#73).

  • Watches (meetings, mail, calendar, Google Chat) in each instance's settings in the apps.
  • A push when a meeting is ready (who spoke, voices to name), failed (why) or has a speaker proposal; the tap opens it.
  • Meetings shows instances' speaker proposals (Confirm/Reject) and lets a named speaker be renamed or forgotten.
  • Mac recordings are CAF and survive a quit or crash; a recording cut short is recovered at launch, an unreadable one is kept and never sent; no idle sleep while recording; sleep shows as a gap with its length; warnings while recording (silent microphone, device restart) and after it; Stop Sending; Record during an upload.
  • iPhone: a phone call is waited out (up to 3 h); a recording that stops early is a notification and a chat banner; gaps say how long nothing was recorded. Stop is on the banner and the meeting's toolbar.
  • Server: capture problems stay on a transcript that still worked; a reprocess keeps the last transcript readable; new unfiled meetings are filed from their calendar event's account.
